risk_definition: Risk score = empirical percentile (0–100) of predicted vegetation-stress severity (-predicted anomaly) against reconstructed 2015–2022 target anomalies for the same source period and horizon. It is a relative index, not a probability.
reference_note: Historical target anomalies were reconstructed from the Earth Engine export using the validated same-period mean baseline method. This follows the original BADIA risk-scoring logic but is not byte-identical to the unavailable original seasonal-anomaly source table.
